body:
## Why (verified evidence)
When a learner fails retrieval, `schedule_from_attempt` enqueues a `reason_code="remediation"` queue item (`src/lms/scheduling/service.py:583-590`). The learner Review UI renders a **Mark reviewed** button for every pending item via `_complete_review_form` (`src/lms/ui/api.py:491-500`) without checking `reason_code`. Completing that item calls `complete_review_queue_item`, which raises for any reason other than `due-review` or `new-learning` (`src/lms/scheduling/repository.py:119-122`). The API maps that to HTTP 409 (`tests/scheduling/test_runtime_wiring.py:185-200`). Remediation rows therefore stay `pending` forever while the UI keeps offering an action that always fails — a latched gate on the remediation drain path.

## Tasks
- [ ] In `src/lms/ui/api.py:491-500`, gate `_complete_review_form` so remediation (and any non-completable `reason_code`) does not render **Mark reviewed**, or render a remediation-specific completion/skip control that calls a supported path.
- [ ] Add a supported completion or `skipped` transition for remediation items in `src/lms/scheduling/repository.py:107-147` (or a dedicated route) so a learner can clear remediation after doing the remedial work; persist audit events in `decision_log`.
- [ ] Wire the new remediation drain into the UI route that posts `/app/learner/reviews/{id}/complete` (or add a sibling route) in `src/lms/ui/api.py`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Named test: `test_remediation_queue_item_can_be_cleared_after_failure` asserting a failed attempt creates a remediation item, the learner can complete or skip it through the supported API/UI path, and `ReviewQueueItem.status` is no longer `pending`.
- Deliberate-break → revert: restore the `reason_code not in {"due-review", "new-learning"}` guard without a remediation drain → confirm `test_remediation_queue_item_can_be_cleared_after_failure` FAILS → revert.

## Non-Goals
- Do NOT change FSRS interval math or success-ramp rules for `due-review` items.
- Do NOT reopen the graph-edge concurrency work tracked in #666.
- No scaffolding / TODO-only changes; every task is a concrete edit verified by the gate above.

_Surfaced by Track D repo-audit refill 2026-09-22 @ `3bdd840`; verified by reading `repository.py:119-122`, `ui/api.py:491-500`, and reproducing HTTP 409 on remediation completion._
